item.title: A small project for the weekend
item.description:
1 min.

This weekend’s project is deliberately small: make a notebook for the things I want to try. One page per idea, with room for a sketch and the next step.

Three things to start with

  1. A place to collect ideas before they get lost.
  2. A short list of materials I already have.
  3. One action I can finish in an afternoon.

The notebook does not need to be beautiful. It needs to be easy to open.

A few useful places

  • The Public Domain Review for unexpected stories and visual inspiration.
  • Project Gutenberg for books to browse and return to.
  • Chulapa for the theme behind this journal.

The next step

I will choose one idea and write down what happened, including the parts that did not work. A small finished experiment teaches me more than a perfect plan.

item.title: An evening walk through Madrid
item.description:
1 min.

A familiar street feels different after dark. The traffic keeps moving, but lit windows and reflections turn an ordinary walk into something worth slowing down for.

Looking up

At Plaza de Cibeles, I stopped to look at the towers instead of the crossing signal. The building glowed against the sky, and for a moment the city seemed to have a completely different rhythm.

A small habit

I want to take more walks without a destination. Just one neighborhood, enough time to look up and no pressure to turn every outing into a plan.

The best part is coming home with something I would otherwise have missed.

item.title: A first story
item.description:
1 min.

Every journal begins with a first story. This is a small space to pause, notice the world around you and share what you find.

A place to begin

I used to wait until I had something big to write about. A finished project, a long trip or an idea polished enough to explain. That left a lot of ordinary days unrecorded.

This time, I am starting with the small things: a good walk, a paragraph from a book and the first rough sketch of a project. They count too.

Keeping it simple

The plan is to write a little, often. Some posts will be stories; others will be a photograph or a short list. Over time, I hope they become a useful record of what caught my attention.

If you are new here, read a little about this journal.
